That doesn't change anything as long as
it was Shuichi who had the receiver.

<CLT=cltMIND>I screwed up! 
I need to think it over again!

had the receiver for the security sensor...

having the receiver in the first place!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to retake control! I have to tell a lie...
so we can get closer to the truth!
